gaps.lead: He was sacked for constantly missing deadlines.
gaps.sentence: If he hadn't kept missing deadlines, he ___ sacked.
gaps.explanation: If + past perfect, would(n't) have been + participle.

gaps.lead: Someone must check this equipment before every flight.
gaps.explanation: must check → must be checked (modal + be + past participle).

gaps.lead: If you don't hurry, you'll miss the bus.
Given that he has no experience, will Glyn be able to do this job?
gaps.sentence: Will Glyn's ___ his ability to do this job?
gaps.hint: no experience = lack of experience (noun subject)
gaps.explanation: The noun subject 'lack of experience' takes the verb 'affect'.

gaps.lead: It's a pity I didn't bring my camera.
gaps.explanation: 'If only I had brought' expresses regret about the past.

gaps.lead: It's pointless to worry about things you can't change.
gaps.sentence: There is ___ things you can't change.
